cards.card_text: Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.
cards.verse_text: The name of the Israelite who was slain with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.
cards.snippet: …the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.

cards.card_text: Then the men of Judah turn to their brothers the Simeonites, another tribe of Israel, with a deal.
cards.verse_text: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight against the Canaanites.
cards.snippet: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight…

cards.card_text: What deal do the men of Judah offer the Simeonites?
cards.verse_text: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight against the Canaanites.
cards.snippet: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight…

cards.card_text: The Simeonites turn down Judah's offer.
cards.verse_text: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight against the Canaanites.
cards.snippet: Then the men of Judah said to their brothers the Simeonites, “Come up with us to our allotted territory, and let us fight…

cards.card_text: Then Judah teams up with their brothers the Simeonites again, and that partnership from the start is still going strong.
cards.verse_text: Then the men of Judah went with their brothers the Simeonites, attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and devoted the city to destruction.
cards.snippet: Then the men of Judah went with their brothers the Simeonites, attacked the Canaanites living in Zephath, and devoted the city to destruction.

cards.card_text: Five hundred Simeonites head out, led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
cards.verse_text: And five hundred of these Simeonites led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, went to Mount Seir
